AdminClaim.title: AdminClaim
AdminClaim.description: Authorized game owner UID record verified for Owner Control Panel access.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

OwnerMeta.title: OwnerMeta
OwnerMeta.description: Secondary salted SHA-256 owner passcode metadata (never plaintext secrets).

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who claimed or rotated the secondary passcode.

claimed.description: Whether the secondary owner passcode is active.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin performing the update.

GameConfigDoc.title: GameConfigDoc
GameConfigDoc.description: Draft or live published game configuration controlled by the Owner Dashboard.

configJson.description: Serialized OwnerConfigDto JSON payload governing maps, missions, police, vehicles, characters, ads, and game settings.

updatedBy.description: UID of the owner publishing or saving draft changes.

publishedAt.description: Server timestamp when published via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest modification via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ConfigBackup.title: ConfigBackup
ConfigBackup.description: Versioned snapshot of published configuration for rollback and restore.

version.description: Version number captured in this backup.

createdBy.description: UID of the owner creating the backup.

PlayerAccount.title: PlayerAccount
PlayerAccount.description: Registered non-PII player gameplay progress and moderation status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

resetRequested.description: Owner-triggered progress reset flag consumed on player sync.

/admins/{uid}.description: Verified game owner accounts permitted to administer maps, missions, police, vehicles, characters, ads, settings, and players.

/ownerConfig/meta.description: Owner-only salted SHA-256 passcode verification metadata.

/gameConfig/{docId}.description: Published ('published') and draft ('draft') Owner Control Panel game configuration documents.

/gameConfig/published/backups/{backupId}.description: Historical published configuration snapshots for owner rollback and restore.

/players/{playerId}.description: Player gameplay progress records managed by players (own doc) and moderated by the owner.
